settings.databases.title: Databases
settings.served.title: Databases oschess sees
settings.served.hint: The databases from ChessBase and from the extra folders. The list updates itself.
settings.folders.title: Extra folders
settings.folders.hint: The bridge shows the databases of these folders in addition to ChessBase's list.
settings.engine.title: Engine
settings.engine.intro: The engine analyses positions from your databases in oschess. The bridge has no engine of its own: it uses one already installed or installs the official Stockfish build.
settings.engine.none.title: No engine found
settings.engine.none.hint: This computer has no Stockfish in the ChessBase and Fritz folders. Without an engine the databases still open, but positions are not analysed.
settings.engine.found.title: Engines found
settings.engine.found.hint: The bridge looks for them in the ChessBase and Fritz folders.
settings.engine.other.title: Another UCI engine
settings.engine.other.hint: choose an .exe file on this computer
settings.engine.refused: This file did not answer as a UCI engine, so it was not chosen.
settings.engine.installHint: Stockfish {version} · official build from GitHub · ≈ {mb} MB · free GPL licence
settings.engine.offer.title: Stockfish {version} is available
settings.engine.offer.hint: {current} is chosen now. The official build from GitHub, ≈ {mb} MB, is checked against its checksum. The engine is updated only with your consent.
settings.general.title: General
settings.autostart.title: Start with Windows
settings.autostart.hint: The bridge starts in the background when you sign in
settings.autostart.blockedHint: Turn on «oschess bridge» in Windows Settings: Apps → Startup
settings.autoUpdate.title: Update automatically
settings.autoUpdate.hint: New versions of the bridge install themselves while it is idle
settings.versionRow.title: Version {version}
settings.versionRow.hint: Updates come from GitHub and are checked against their signature
settings.versionRow.off: This build does not check for updates
settings.versionRow.store: Updates come from the Microsoft Store
settings.connection.title: Connection to oschess
settings.code.title: Pairing code
settings.code.hint: Needed only when oschess did not connect by itself
settings.code.warning: A new code disconnects the browsers already paired: they must pair again.
settings.port.title: Port {port}
settings.port.hint: Change it only when another program already uses this port
settings.port.label: New port
settings.port.error: A port is a number from 1024 to 65535.
wizard.title: Let's set up the bridge
wizard.subtitle: Three steps. Everything found is already chosen, so «Next» is usually all it takes. You can change it all later in the settings.
wizard.databases.lead: The bridge took the list of your databases from ChessBase and will show them in oschess. The list updates itself when you add databases in ChessBase.
wizard.databases.leadNone: The bridge shows in oschess the databases from ChessBase and from the folders you add.
wizard.databases.none.title: No ChessBase databases found
wizard.databases.none.hint: The bridge found no ChessBase databases on this computer: the program is not installed, or the databases were simply copied to the disk. Add the folder with your databases (.2cbh, .cbh) and the bridge shows every database in it.
wizard.databases.addHint: Databases outside ChessBase's list? Add their folder.
wizard.databases.later: You can add a folder later too
wizard.engine.later: You can go on without an engine and add one later
wizard.engine.installing: «Next» becomes available once Stockfish is installed
wizard.engine.verify: After the download the bridge checks the build's checksum, unpacks it and chooses it.
wizard.engine.recommend.title: We recommend installing Stockfish {version}
wizard.engine.recommend.hint: None of the engines found is the latest Stockfish, {version}. Install it now: it is the strongest version, and its analysis is more accurate. The engines found stay in the list.
wizard.startup.lead: The bridge runs in the background, its mark is by the clock. oschess sees your databases only while the bridge runs.
wizard.startup.autostartHint: The bridge starts in the background when you sign in, so your databases are in oschess right away.
wizard.done.title: All set
wizard.done.subtitle: All that is left is to connect oschess in your browser.
wizard.done.noEngineHint: positions are not analysed until you add one
wizard.done.changeLater: You can change it in the settings
firstRun.opening.title: Opening oschess in your browser to connect…
firstRun.opening.hint: The browser asks for permission to access the local network — choose «Allow».
firstRun.connected.title: oschess is connected
firstRun.connected.hint: Your ChessBase databases are in the oschess Library now. You can close this window.
firstRun.manual.title: Paste the code by hand
firstRun.manual.hint: If the page did not open or did not connect: in oschess, open the Library → ChessBase → «Paste the code by hand» and paste this code.
updates.awaitingConsent: Update found. Confirm the download in the Windows dialog; waiting for the download to finish.
updates.waitingIdle: Update downloaded. Waiting for database and engine work to finish before restarting the bridge safely.
updates.waitingRestart: Update downloaded. Waiting until Windows allows the bridge to restart automatically — about a minute after startup.
updates.installing: Installing the update. Confirm any Windows prompt. The bridge will restart.
updates.current.store: Microsoft Store is not offering an update for this copy right now. Installed version: {version}.
updates.current.direct: No updates on GitHub. Installed version: {version}.
updates.available: An update is available. Choose “Check now” to install it through Windows.
updates.required: A required update is available. Choose “Check now” to install it through Windows.
updates.declined: Update cancelled in the Windows dialog. You can try again.
updates.storeOpened: The update could not finish here. Microsoft Store was opened — choose “Update” there.
updates.restartRequired: Windows or the installer finished the request. Restart the bridge and check its version.
updates.updated: The bridge was updated to version {version}.
updates.failed: Could not check for or install the update. Check your internet connection and try again.
